stories.title: Conselho de pastores diz que ‘evangélicos e católicos vivem em paz’ e critica Lula por fake news

en.title: Pastor council says 'evangelicals and Catholics live in peace' and criticizes Lula for fake news
en.summary: A council of pastors stated that evangelical and Catholic communities coexist peacefully while criticizing President Lula regarding misinformation.

stories.title: Combustíveis: governo endurece fiscalização e prevê multa de até R$ 500 milhões

en.title: Fuels: government tightens inspection and forecasts fines up to R$ 500 million
en.summary: The government is intensifying fuel inspections and plans to impose penalties reaching up to 500 million reais.

stories.title: Obra anti-Brexit de Banksy avaliada em mais de R$ 9 milhões vai a leilão

en.title: Banksy's anti-Brexit work valued at over R$ 9 million goes to auction
en.summary: A Banksy installation titled "Keep Out" with anti-Brexit messaging will be auctioned in London in October during Phillips auction house's contemporary art sales.

stories.title: Prêmio Jabuti anuncia semifinalistas da 68ª edição

en.title: Jabuti Prize announces semifinalists for 68th edition
en.summary: The Brazilian Book Chamber announced semifinalists for the 68th Jabuti Prize, with the awards ceremony scheduled for October 27 in São Paulo, featuring 23 categories across four areas.

stories.title: Petrobras assina contrato de 22 anos com norte-americana Cheniere para compra de gás

en.title: Petrobras signs 22-year contract with U.S. company Cheniere for gas purchase
en.summary: Petrobras has entered into a 22-year agreement with American firm Cheniere for the purchase of gas.

stories.title: Prêmio Jabuti indica Itamar Vieira Jr., Aline Bei e Adélia Prado; veja semifinalistas

en.title: Jabuti Prize indicates Itamar Vieira Jr., Aline Bei and Adélia Prado; see semifinalists
en.summary: The Jabuti Prize announced ten semifinalists in each of its 23 categories. Five finalists will be selected on October 14, with winners announced on October 27 at a ceremony in São Paulo.

stories.title: Leandro Karnal e Carolina Delboni estão entre semifinalistas do Jabuti 2026; veja lista completa

en.title: Leandro Karnal and Carolina Delboni are among Jabuti 2026 semifinalists; see complete list
en.summary: Leandro Karnal and Carolina Delboni have been included among the semifinalists for the 2026 Jabuti Prize.

stories.title: Claude sofre interrupção e fica fora do ar nesta terça-feira (29)

en.title: Claude suffers outage and goes offline on Tuesday (29)
en.summary: Claude experienced a service interruption and was unavailable on Tuesday the 29th.

stories.title: Linha 17-ouro do metrô de SP passa a funcionar das 6h às 22h nesta quarta (30)

en.title: Line 17-Gold of São Paulo metro starts operating from 6am to 10pm this Wednesday (30)
en.summary: São Paulo's Line 17-Gold metro begins operating from 6am to 10pm starting Wednesday, maintaining these hours Monday through Saturday. Service remains free during the testing phase.

stories.title: Petrobras assina acordo de 22 anos com a americana Cheniere para compra e venda de gás natural

en.title: Petrobras signs 22-year agreement with American Cheniere for natural gas purchase and sale
en.summary: Petrobras entered into a long-term liquefied natural gas contract with Cheniere Marketing, the subsidiary of the United States' leading LNG producer and exporter.

stories.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (29)

en.title: Check the agenda of presidential candidates on Tuesday (29)
en.summary: Presidential candidates scheduled activities including interviews, public appearances, and supporter meetings in various regions across the country on Tuesday.

stories.title: Linha 17-Ouro do monotrilho passa a funcionar das 6h às 22h

en.title: Line 17-Gold of the monorail starts operating from 6am to 10pm
en.summary: São Paulo's Line 17-Gold metro begins operating from 6am to 10pm Monday through Saturday, with trips remaining free of charge.

stories.title: Grupo TLJ lança Cockpit AI, equipe de agentes de IA no CRM

en.title: TLJ Group launches Cockpit AI, team of AI agents in CRM
en.summary: TLJ Group unveiled Cockpit AI, an application integrating artificial intelligence agents into company CRM systems to automate commercial tasks including funnel analysis, data cleanup, and priority management.

stories.title: Eli Lilly diz que Zepbound supera versão de alta dose do Wegovy em perda de peso

en.title: Eli Lilly says Zepbound outperforms high-dose version of Wegovy in weight loss
en.summary: Eli Lilly reported that specific doses of its Zepbound weight-loss medication achieved greater weight reduction than the high-dose version of competitor Novo's Wegovy product.

stories.title: Consultas podem evitar 75% das deficiências visuais

en.title: Consultations can prevent 75% of visual impairments
en.summary: Regular eye consultations can prevent approximately 75% of visual impairment cases, as many eye diseases progress without symptoms and cause permanent damage when diagnosed too late.

stories.title: Governo estima R$ 67,5 bi em receitas extras com efeitos guerra, diz secretário do Tesouro

en.title: Government estimates R$ 67.5 billion in extra revenues from war effects, says Treasury secretary
en.summary: Brazil's government projects 67.5 billion reais in additional 2026 revenues related to Middle East war effects, while committed spending and revenue forgone already reach 32.4 billion reais.

stories.title: Sparta levanta R$ 370 milhões em oferta de fundo de infraestrutura listado em bolsa

en.title: Sparta raises 370 million reais in listed infrastructure fund offering
en.summary: Sparta's infrastructure fund PREE11 raised 370 million reais in its second share offering, bringing its assets to approximately 400 million reais. The offering was supported by the fund's strategy of seeking fixed returns in an environment of elevated interest rates and the beginning of Selic rate cuts.
